purpose: Define what the portable Forex checkpoint preserves and how excluded data is recreated.

included: runtime source, tests, scripts, configuration, and documentation
model registry, lifecycle metadata, promotion metadata, and selected compact fitted artifacts
current compact account and signal state without credentials
model-gap qualification, runtime, benchmark, and canary results
canonical matrix manifests, coverage table, and coverage-repair audit
compact M1 validation fixture and fixture manifest
exact package inventory, bootstrap requirements, and pinned source commits
safe importer, bootstrap wrapper, validation profiles, and expected assertions
excluded: credentials, tokens, private keys, and environment files
raw S1 quote streams, order-book/depth feeds, candles, and bulk feature panels
active SQLite databases and WAL/SHM files
downloaded foundation-model weights and external repository working trees
paper or live account process state

canonical_prediction_space.contract: Every eligible model signal contributes to the consolidated signal matrix with model, pair, input timeframe, exact outcome horizon, costs, eligibility, and maturity retained as separate dimensions.

recreation_stages.command: Create four isolated Python 3.12 environments from trad/config/runtime_requirements/requirements-*-bootstrap.txt, then compare against trad/config/vault_runtime_lock.json.

recreation_stages.notes: OANDA can backfill S5 candles. True historical S1 quote/depth data cannot be reconstructed and must accumulate prospectively.

Builds the 68-pair, 13-input-timeframe, 16-outcome-horizon contract where executable observations exist. Deep M1 features provide the full-span M1-and-slower panels; observed S5 execution provides 30-second supplements. Run oanda_model_gap_coverage_repair.py for sparse cells. The state and repair reports must record quote-unavailable pair-cells explicitly and must never manufacture outcomes.

recreation_stages.command: Run the shared panel tabular/neural benchmark scripts against the recreated panel and preserve split, pair, timeframe, horizon, units, and costs in every result.

non_recreatable_data.data: historical S1 quote and intrasecond sequence
non_recreatable_data.replacement: resume prospective collection after storage is reliable
resume prospective depth collection; do not infer it from candles
